# appmixer_system_config (Resource)

Manages a single tenant configuration entry. Only string values are supported.

~> Changes to `key` or `value` force replacement — the Appmixer API has no update path for config entries.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appmixer_system_config" "jwt" {
  key   = "JWTSecret"
  value = var.jwt_secret
}

variable "jwt_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Configuration key name, e.g. `JWTSecret`. Changes force replacement.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Configuration value. Sensitive. Changes force replacement.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import appmixer_system_config.jwt JWTSecret
```
